grc:verb:ποιεῖται.gloss: third-person singular present mediopassive indicative contracted of ποιέω (poiéō)

grc:adj:ἄξεινος.gloss: inhospitable, not welcoming to strangers or guests

grc:noun:ἕταρος.gloss: Epic and Doric form of ἑταῖρος (hetaîros)

grc:verb:ἰών.gloss: present active participle of εἶμι (eîmi, “to go”)

grc:verb:εἴποις.gloss: second-person singular aorist active optative of εἶπον (eîpon)

grc:verb:πέπνυμαι.gloss: to be conscious, in full possession of one's faculties

grc:noun:ἱστίη.gloss: Epic and Ionic form of ἑστίᾱ (hestíā)

grc:name:Μοῖρα.gloss: one of the Moirae; one of the Fates in Greek mythology

grc:verb:τέτυκται.gloss: third-person singular perfect mediopassive indicative of τεύχω (teúkhō)

grc:verb:ποιῶν.gloss: contracted present active participle of ποιέω (poiéō)

grc:adj:δωδεκαταῖος.gloss: on the twelfth day, in twelve days

grc:verb:ἔστε.gloss: up to the time that, until

grc:adv:ἔστε.gloss: up to the time that, until

grc:noun:φήμη.gloss: utterance prompted by the gods, significant

grc:verb:ἀπόλλυται.gloss: third-person singular present mediopassive indicative of ἀπόλλυμι (apóllumi)

grc:adv:Διόθεν.gloss: sent from Zeus, according to his will

grc:verb:γείνατο.gloss: third-person singular aorist middle indicative unaugmented of γείνομαι (geínomai)

grc:noun:νῆμα.gloss: that which is spun, thread, yarn

grc:adj:φυτοῖσιν.gloss: masculine/neuter dative plural of φῠτός (phŭtós) with movable nu

grc:noun:φυτοῖσιν.gloss: dative plural of φῠτόν (phŭtón) with movable nu

grc:noun:κούρη.gloss: Epic and Ionic form of κόρη (kórē)

grc:noun:ἵστωρ.gloss: judge (one who knows the law and what is right)

grc:verb:φασίν.gloss: third-person plural present active indicative of φημῐ́ (phēmĭ́) with movable nu

grc:verb:ἀμφιπολεύω.gloss: serve as an attendant, tend, care for

grc:verb:πέλονται.gloss: third-person plural present mediopassive indicative of πέλω (pélō)

grc:pron:αἱ.gloss: feminine nominative plural of ὁ (ho, demonstrative pronoun)
